# Monitoring and Observability Standards

This directory contains standards for implementing monitoring, logging, tracing, and observability in applications.
page_texts.4:
[standards/application/monitoring/README.md#std-app-mon-001-monitoring-and-observability]

### STD-APP-MON-001: Monitoring and Observability

Standards for implementing comprehensive observability including structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics collection, health checks, and alerting strategies.
page_texts.5:
[standards/application/monitoring/README.md#std-app-mon-002-opentelemetry-observability-standard]

### STD-APP-MON-002: OpenTelemetry Observability Standard

Enterprise requirements for OpenTelemetry (OTel) adoption across all application services. Covers all three telemetry signals (traces, metrics, logs), language-specific implementation guidance (.NET, Java, Python, Node.js), OTel Collector deployment topologies, sampling strategies, security controls for PII/PHI, and approved backends.
page_texts.6:
[standards/application/monitoring/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

These standards ensure:
- Comprehensive application observability
- Consistent logging and metrics practices
- Effective troubleshooting and debugging
- Performance monitoring and optimization
- Proactive issue detection and alerting
